rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The obscene act means their circumambulating the House naked.
rows.anchor: فاحشة } يعني: طوافهم بالبيت عارين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's command of justice refutes their claim that He commanded naked circumambulation; al-qist means justice.
rows.anchor: رد لقولهم: { والله أمرنا بها } والقسط: العدل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Orient yourselves toward the Kaaba wherever you are when praying.
rows.anchor: وجهوا وجوهكم حيث ما كنتم في الصلاة إلى الكعبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship God alone and associate nothing with Him.
rows.anchor: وحدوه ولا تشركوا به شيئا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As at creation, people are divided into the wretched and the blessed, and return as wretched or blessed.
rows.anchor: في الخلق شيقيا وسعيدا، فكذلك، { تعودون } سعداء وأشقياء

words: فَرِيقًا هَدَىٰ وَفَرِيقًا حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The guided group are God's allies; those for whom error is decreed are allies of devils.
rows.anchor: أرشد إلى دينه، وهم أولياؤه { وفريقا حق عليهم الضلالة } أضلهم، وهم أولياء الشياطين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The misguided take devils as protectors yet imagine themselves rightly guided.
rows.anchor: إنهم اتخذوا الشياطين أولياء من دون الله ويحسبون أنهم مهتدون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The required adornment is whatever covers the private parts.
rows.anchor: يعني: ما وارى العورة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This applies at prayer or circumambulation.
rows.anchor: لصلاة أو طواف { وكلوا واشربوا }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the Jāhiliyya, pilgrims ate only staple rations and avoided fat during pilgrimage to magnify it; Muslims said they had more right to do so.
rows.anchor: كان أهل الجاهلية لا يأكلون أيام حجهم إلا قوتا، ولا يأكلون دسما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God permits meat and fat, milk, water, and whatever else He has made lawful.
rows.anchor: يعني: اللحم والدسم { واشربوا } اللبن والماء وما أحل لكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not forbid yourselves meat and fat that God has made lawful.
rows.anchor: بحظركم على أنفسكم ما قد أحللته لكم من اللحم والدسم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's not loving such people means He does not reward them or admit them to Paradise.
rows.anchor: من فعل ذلك، أي: لا يثيبه ولا يدخله الجنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It means they had not lived or settled there.
rows.anchor: لم يقيموا فيها، ولم ينزلوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb's question rhetorically denies that he grieves intensely over a disbelieving people: he does not grieve for them.
rows.anchor: كيف يشتد حزني عليهم، ومعناه: الإنكار أي: لا آسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They transgressed and acted arrogantly by continuing the forbidden fishing for whales on the Sabbath.
rows.anchor: أي: طغوا واستكبروا { عن ما نهوا عنه } أي: عن ترك ما نهوا عنه من صيد الحيتان يوم السبت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The account of what God said to them is explained in Surat al-Baqara.
rows.anchor: الآية مفسرة في سورة البقرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means that God announced what He would do.
rows.anchor: قال وأعلم ربك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Punishment is imposed on the Jews until the Resurrection; Muhammad and his community will fight them or take the jizya from them.
rows.anchor: على اليهود { من يسومهم } أي: يذيقهم { سوء العذاب } إلى يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God quickly punishes those who merit having their punishment hastened.
rows.anchor: لمن استحق تعجيله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God scattered them among different lands, so they no longer shared a united community.
rows.anchor: فرقناهم في البلاد، فلم يجتمع لهم كلمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The righteous are those who believed; the others are those who disbelieved.
rows.anchor: منهم الصالحون } وهم الذين آمنوا { ومنهم دون ذلك } الذين كفروا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Good things mean prosperity and well-being; bad things mean drought and hardships.
rows.anchor: بالحسنات } بالخصب والعافية { والسيئات } الجدب والشدائد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These trials were intended to bring them to repentance.
rows.anchor: كي يتوبوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people being called are the polytheists; even when invited to guidance, they do not follow.
rows.anchor: يعني: المشركين { إلى الهدى لا يتبعوكم

words: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those invoked besides God are idols, created and owned beings.
rows.anchor: يعني: الأصنام { عباد } مملوكون مخلوقون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The challenge asks whether idols can reward, requite, or benefit their worshippers, exposing claims that they provide benefit, reward, or intercession.
rows.anchor: فاعبدوهم هل يثيبونكم أو يجازونكم!؟ { إن كنتم صادقين } أن لكم عند الأصنام منفعة، أو ثوابا، أو شفاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The questions contrast idols with human beings, who can walk and grasp with their limbs.
rows.anchor: مشي بني آدم { أم لهم أيد يبطشون بها } يتناولون بها مثل بطش بني آدم

words: أَمْ لَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌۭ يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَآ أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَاذَانٌۭ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idols also lack the sight and hearing that human beings possess.
rows.anchor: أم لهم أعين يبصرون بها أم لهم آذان يسمعون بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet challenges the polytheists and their partners to plot against him without delay.
rows.anchor: الذين تعبدون من دون الله { ثم كيدون } أنتم وشركاؤكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are told not to give him respite, but to hurry in plotting against him.
rows.anchor: لا تمهلون واعجلوا في كيدي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is the Prophet's protector, guardian, and helper.
rows.anchor: الذي يتولى حفظي ونصري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Book revealed by God is the Qur'an.
rows.anchor: القرآن { وهو يتولى الصالحين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God cares for the righteous, who do not associate anything with Him.
rows.anchor: الذين لا يعدلون بالله شيئا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those near their Lord are the angels, close to God's mercy.
rows.anchor: يعني: الملائكة، وهم بالقرب من رحمة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Despite their rank, the angels worship God; a being greater than a human does not disdain worshipping God.
rows.anchor: أي: هم مع منزلتهم ودرجتهم يعبدون الله. كأنه قيل: من هو أكبر منك أيها الإنسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their glorification means declaring God free of evil.
rows.anchor: ينزهونه عن السوء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels prostrate to God.
rows.anchor: ينزهونه عن السوء { وله يسجدون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hypocritical men and women share one religion.
rows.anchor: على دين بعض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their commanding what is wrong means calling people to disbelieve in Muhammad.
rows.anchor: بالكفر بمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their forbidding what is right means discouraging people from following Muhammad.
rows.anchor: عن اتباعه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They withhold their money from spending in God's cause.
rows.anchor: عن النفقة في سبيل الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They abandoned God's commands, so He left them deprived of all good and forsook them.
rows.anchor: تركوا أمر الله، فتركهم من كل خير وخذلهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypocrites are those who depart from what God commanded.
rows.anchor: الخارجون عما أمر الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The addressees acted as earlier peoples had acted.
rows.anchor: أي: فعلتم كأفعال الذين من قبلكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Earlier peoples were content with their worldly share, and the addressees did likewise.
rows.anchor: رضوا بنصيبهم من الدنيا، ففعلتم أنتم أيضا مثل ما فعلوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They joined earlier peoples in attacking the Prophet, as those peoples had attacked their prophets.
rows.anchor: في الطعن على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كما خاضوا في الطعن على أنبيائهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their deeds are null because they are not accepted and earn no reward.
rows.anchor: لأنها لا تقبل منهم ولا يثابون عليها

words: أَلَمْ يَأْتِهِمْ نَبَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The news concerns earlier peoples destroyed in this world for their sins, so that the audience might take warning.
rows.anchor: خبر الذين أهلكوا في الدنيا بذنوبهم، فيتعظوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of Abraham are identified as Nimrod.
rows.anchor: يعني: نمروذ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of Midian are the people of Shuayb.
rows.anchor: أصحاب مدين } قوم شعيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The overturned cities are the towns of Lot's people.
rows.anchor: وأصحاب المؤتفكات، وهي قرى قوم لوط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God would not punish them before sending a messenger.
rows.anchor: ليعذبهم قبل بعث الرسول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They wronged themselves by rejecting the messengers.
rows.anchor: بتكذيب الرسل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believing men and women are allies through compassion and love.
rows.anchor: في الرحمة والمحبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Enjoining good means calling people to Islam.
rows.anchor: يدعون إلى الإسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Forbidding wrong means forbidding association of others with God.
rows.anchor: الشرك بالله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The covenant maker was Thalaba ibn Hatib, who vowed to give everyone their due if God enriched him; after God did so, he withheld alms.
rows.anchor: يعني: ثعلبة بن حاطب، عاهد ربه لئن وسع عليه أن يؤتى كل ذي حق حقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They vowed to give charity and to act with their wealth as righteous people do.
rows.anchor: لنعطين الصدقة، { ولنكونن من الصالحين } ولنعملن ما يعمل أهل الصلاح في أموالهم

words: فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ بَخِلُوا۟ بِهِۦ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When God gave them His bounty, they were stingy with it and turned away.
rows.anchor: فلما آتاهم من فضله بخلوا به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their broken vow and false covenant led to lasting hypocrisy: they were deprived of repentance and died hypocrites.
rows.anchor: صير عاقبة أمرهم إلى ذلك بحرمان التوبة، حتى ماتوا على النفاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Messenger took a third of their wealth, and the charity expiated their sins.
rows.anchor: فأخذ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثلث أموالهم، وكانت كفارة للذنوب التي أصابوها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The charity purifies them from sins.
rows.anchor: هذه الصدقة تطهرهم من الذنوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Through the charity, Muhammad raises them from the ranks of hypocrites.
rows.anchor: ترفعهم أنت يا محمد بهذه الصدقة من منازل المنافقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command is to supplicate for them.
rows.anchor: ادع لهم { إن صلاتك سكن لهم } إن دعواتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's supplications reassure them that God accepted their repentance.
rows.anchor: إن دعواتك مما تسكن نفوسهم إليه بأن قد تاب الله عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God hears what they say and knows their remorse.
rows.anchor: لقولهم { عليم } بندامتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God accepts the charitable alms.
rows.anchor: ويأخذ الصدقات } يقبلها { وأن الله هو التواب الرحيم }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God responds to those who turn to Him with mercy and forgiveness.
rows.anchor: يرجع على من يرجع إليه بالرحمة والمغفرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This promises abundant rainfall.
rows.anchor: كثير الدر. يعني: المطر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The added strength means wealth and children.
rows.anchor: يعني: المال والولد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God had withheld rain for three years and made their women barren; Hud promised belief would bring revived land, wealth, and children.
rows.anchor: قد حبس عنهم المطر ثلاث سنين، وأعقم أرحام نسائهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They denied Hud's prophethood and claimed he had brought no clear proof.
rows.anchor: منكرين لنبوته: { يا هود ما جئتنا ببينة } بحجة واضحة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word means that something afflicted or touched him.
rows.anchor: أصابك ومسك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They alleged an idol had made Hud insane and damaged his mind, so that he exposed its faults.
rows.anchor: بجنون فأفسد عقلك، فالذي يظهر من عيبها لما لحق عقلك من التغيير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hud says that if they think idols punished him for criticizing them, he will criticize them even more.
rows.anchor: إن كانت عندكم الأصنام أنها عاقبتني لطعني عليها، فإني أزيد الآن في الطعن عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hud tells them and their idols to conspire together against him.
rows.anchor: احتالوا أنتم وأوثانكم في عداوتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He challenges them not to delay or give him respite.
rows.anchor: لا تؤجلون

words: مَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذٌۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every creature is in God's grasp and subject to whatever His power wills for it.
rows.anchor: أي: هي في قبضته، وتنالها بما شاء قدرته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The religion God sent Hud with is a straight religion.
rows.anchor: إن الذي بعثني الله به دين مستقيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning away means rejecting the call to believe.
rows.anchor: تتولوا، بمعنى: تعرضوا عما دعوتكم إليه من الإيمان

words: فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَيْكُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hud's delivery of his message establishes the proof against them.
rows.anchor: فقد ثبتت الحجة عليكم بإبلاغي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will replace them with people more obedient to Him.
rows.anchor: ويخلف بعدكم من هو أطوع له منكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their turning away harms only themselves, not God.
rows.anchor: ولا تضرونه } بإعراضكم { شيئا } إنما تضرون أنفسكم

words: إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God watches every deed and will requite people for their deeds.
rows.anchor: إن ربي على كل شيء } من أعمال العباد { حفيظ } حتى يجازيهم عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command refers to the destruction of the people of ʿĀd.
rows.anchor: بهلاك عاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God saved Hud and the believers by guiding them to faith and protecting them from disbelief.
rows.anchor: حيث هديناهم إلى الإيمان، وعصمناهم من الكفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The severe punishment is what was inflicted on those who disbelieved.
rows.anchor: يعني: ما عذب به الذين كفروا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening of this account was explained in Surat al-Aʿrāf.
rows.anchor: ذكرنا تفسير هذه الآية في سورة الأعراف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They enjoy prosperity and fertility; with God's blessings, money, and low prices, they have no need to cheat in measures.
rows.anchor: يعني: النعمة والخصب، يقول: أي حاجة بكم إلى التطفيف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He warns of a punishment that will surround them so none can escape.
rows.anchor: يوعدهم بعذاب يحيط بهم فلا يفلت منهم أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They must complete measures and weights fairly.
rows.anchor: أتموهما بالعدل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's remainder is what remains after full measure and weight; it is better than the quick gain from cheating.
rows.anchor: ما أبقى الله لكم بعد إيفاء الكيل والوزن { خير لكم } من البخس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The condition of faith is stated because they recognize the truth of Shuayb's words only if they believe in God's blessings.
rows.anchor: [مصدقين] في نعمه. شرط الإيمان لأنهم إنما يعرفون صحة ما يقول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb was not commanded to fight them or force them to believe.
rows.anchor: لم أؤمر بقتالكم وإكراهكم على الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They mean Shuayb's religion when they speak of his prayers commanding him.
rows.anchor: يريدون: دينك يأمرك، أي: أفي دينك الأمر بذا؟

words: أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَٰٓؤُا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They object to being forbidden from cheating, wrongdoing, and reducing measures and weights.
rows.anchor: من البخس والظلم، ونقص المكيال والميزان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They call him foolish and ignorant, using 'forbearing and rightly guided' sarcastically.
rows.anchor: الحليم الرشيد على طريق الاستهزاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means, 'Do you know?'
rows.anchor: قال يا قوم أرأيتم } أعلمتم { إن كنت على بينة من ربي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The proof from his Lord is clear evidence and an argument.
rows.anchor: بيان وحجة من ربي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The good provision is lawful wealth; Shuayb had a great deal of money.
rows.anchor: حلالا، وذلك أنه كان كثير المال

words: إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّى
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The answer to 'if' is omitted: would he, with proof and lawful wealth, follow error by cheating and short-measuring?
rows.anchor: على معنى: إن كنت على بينة من ربي ورزقني المال الحلال

words: وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنْهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He does not forbid them from something and then do it himself; he chooses for them what he chooses for himself.
rows.anchor: لست أنهاكم عن شيء وأدخل فيه، وإنما أختار لكم ما أختار لنفسي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He seeks to set right his relationship with them by calling them to worship God alone and act as God-fearing people do.
rows.anchor: ما أريد { إلا الإصلاح } فيما بيني وبينكم بأن تعبدوا الله وحده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This means as far as his ability to convey the message and warn permits.
rows.anchor: أي: بقدر طاقتي، وطاقة الإبلاغ والإنذار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Neither Shuayb nor anyone else can obey except through God's enabling grace.
rows.anchor: لا يقدر هو ولا غيره على الطاعة إلا بتوفيق الله سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He returns to God at the Resurrection.
rows.anchor: أرجع في المعاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The thunder is an angel appointed over the clouds.
rows.anchor: وهو الملك الموكل بالسحاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sound heard from thunder is its glorification of God.
rows.anchor: وهو ما يسمع من صوته، وذلك تسبيح لله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels glorify God out of fear and awe of Him.
rows.anchor: وتسبح الملائكة من خيفة الله تعالى وخشيته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lightning bolts burn what they strike, and their light spreads over the earth.
rows.anchor: وهي التي تحرق من برق السحاب، وينتشر على الأرض ضوؤه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A lightning bolt struck Arbad when he argued with the Prophet and asked whether their Lord was made of copper or iron.
rows.anchor: وكان أربد جادل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: أخبرني عن ربنا، أمن نحاس أم حديد؟ فأحرقته الصاعقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The conjunction wāw is circumstantial: this happens while they dispute about God.
rows.anchor: والواو للحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase describes punishment, meaning strength.
rows.anchor: العقوبة أي: القوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone is rightly invoked by His creation; the true invocation is the declaration that there is no god but God.
rows.anchor: لله من خلقه الدعوة الحق، وهي كلمة التوحيد لا إله إلا الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who invoke besides God are the polytheists calling on idols.
rows.anchor: يعني: المشركين يدعون { من دونه } الأصنام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their invocation is as futile as someone beckoning water to reach his mouth: the water cannot reach it by being called.
rows.anchor: إلا كما يستجاب للذي يبسط كفيه يشير إلى الماء، ويدعوه إلى فيه

words: وَمَا دُعَآءُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers' worship of idols ends in ruin and is futile.
rows.anchor: عبادتهم الأصنام { إلا في ضلال } هلاك وبطلان

words: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ طَوْعًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who prostrate willingly are the angels and believers.
rows.anchor: يعني: الملائكة والمؤمنين { وكرها }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those compelled to prostrate do so out of fear of the sword; although the wording is general, its intended referent is specific.
rows.anchor: وهم من أكرهوا على السجود، فسجدوا لله سبحانه من خوف السيف، واللفظ عام والمراد به الخصوص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every person's shadow, believer or disbeliever, prostrates morning and evening; people do not know how this occurs.
rows.anchor: كل شخص مؤمن أو كافر فإن ظله يسجد لله، ونحن لا نقف على كيفية ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The water sent down from heaven is rain.
rows.anchor: يعني: المطر { فسالت أودية } جمع واد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Awdiyah is the plural of wādī, valley.
rows.anchor: جمع واد { بقدرها } بقدر ما يملأها. أراد بالماء القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The measure is the amount that fills each valley; allegorically, rain is the Qur'an and valleys are hearts, which receive different shares: much, little, or none.
rows.anchor: بقدر ما يملأها. أراد بالماء القرآن، وبالأودية القلوب، والمعنى: أنزل قرآنا فقبلته القلوب بأقدارها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Foam is what rises above the water, high over it.
rows.anchor: وهو ما يعلو الماء { رابيا } عاليا فوقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Foam represents disbelief and falsehood: though it may appear to prevail temporarily, God erases it and gives the outcome to truth and its people.
rows.anchor: والزبد مثل الكفر. يريد: إن الباطل - وإن ظهر على الحق في بعض الأحوال - فإن الله سيمحقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The foam that goes away is what the valley casts out.
rows.anchor: وهو ما رمى به الوادي

words: وَأَمَّا مَا يَنفَعُ ٱلنَّاسَ فَيَمْكُثُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What remains is what benefits people, such as vegetation that grows for pasture.
rows.anchor: مما ينبت المرعى { فيمكث } يبقى { في الأرض }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The second parable concerns ores fired to make jewelry or vessels: gold and silver make jewelry, while copper and lead make utensils.
rows.anchor: يعني: جواهر الأرض من الذهب والفضة والنحاس وغيرها مما يدخل النار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The metals too have a foam-like dross, some of which the bellows expel.
rows.anchor: أي: مثل زبد الماء. يريد: إن من هذه الجواهر بعضها خبث ينفيه الكير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sets out truth and falsehood through these examples; the verse has an advance and delay in its wording, with the meaning explained above.
rows.anchor: وهذه الآية فيها تقديم وتأخير في اللفظ، والمعنى ما أخبرتك به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The city is Sodom, the city of Lot's people.
rows.anchor: مدينة قوم لوط، وهي سذوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They were pleased in expectation of sexual immorality after hearing that handsome young men were in Lot's house.
rows.anchor: يفرحون طمعا منهم في ركوب المعاصي والفاحشة حيث أخبروا أن في بيت لوط مردا حسانا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot asks them not to disgrace him in front of his guests by attacking them, as this would show he has no standing with them.
rows.anchor: عندهم بقصدكم إياهم، فيعلموا أنه ليس لي عندكم قدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This phrase is discussed in Surat Hud.
rows.anchor: مذكور في سورة هود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They say they forbade Lot from hosting strangers because they wanted to commit sexual assault and targeted outsiders.
rows.anchor: عن ضيافتهم؛ لأنا نريد منهم الفاحشة، وكانوا يقصدون بفعلهم الغرباء

words: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِى إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot offers his daughters for marriage as lawful sexual fulfillment, seeking to protect his guests.
rows.anchor: هذا الشأن. يعني: اللذة وقضاء الوطر. يقول: عليكم بتزوجهن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The oath means 'by your life,' addressed to Muhammad.
rows.anchor: بحياتك يا محمد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people meant are Muhammad's people, persisting blindly in their error.
rows.anchor: إن قومك { لفي سكرتهم يعمهون } في ضلالتهم يتمادون

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An alternative says the people meant are Lot's people.
rows.anchor: في ضلالتهم يتمادون. وقيل: يعني: قوم لوط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gabriel cried out at them with a cry that destroyed them.
rows.anchor: صاح بهم جبريل عليه السلام صيحة أهلكتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They were struck at sunrise, when the destruction was completed.
rows.anchor: داخلين في وقت شروق الشمس، وذلك أن تمام الهلاك كان مع الإشراق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's command means the punishment of those who remain in polytheism; it has drawn near and will certainly come.
rows.anchor: أي: عذابه لمن أقام على الشرك، أي: قد قرب ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They should not hasten the punishment because it will certainly come.
rows.anchor: فإنه نازل بكم لا محالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is free of defect and exalted by His attributes above what the polytheists associate with Him.
rows.anchor: براءة له من السوء { وتعالى } ارتفع بصفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angel is Gabriel alone, and the spirit is revelation from God's command.
rows.anchor: يعني: جبريل عليه السلام وحده { بالروح } بالوحي { من أمره } والوحي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's chosen servants are the prophets selected for messengership.
rows.anchor: يريد: النبيين الذين يختصهم بالرسالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 'Warn' is an appositive (badal) for 'the spirit'; it means to inform the disbelievers.
rows.anchor: بدل من الروح، أي: أعلموا أهل الكفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning tells them there is no deity but God and frightens them if they do not acknowledge it.
rows.anchor: مع تخويفهم إن لم يقروا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fearing God means affirming His oneness and obeying Him.
rows.anchor: بالتوحيد والطاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The human created from a drop of fluid is Ubayy ibn Khalaf.
rows.anchor: يعني: أبي بن خلف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ubayy became an outspoken disputant by arguing with the Prophet over denial of resurrection.
rows.anchor: وذلك أنه خاصم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في إنكاره البعث

words: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ رَّسُولًا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sent a messenger to every community just as He sent Muhammad to these people.
rows.anchor: كما بعثناك في هؤلاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The messengers called people to worship God.
rows.anchor: بأن اعبدوا الله { واجتنبوا الطاغوت } الشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taghut means Satan and everyone who calls people to error.
rows.anchor: الشيطان وكل من يدعو إلى الضلالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some were guided by God, meaning that He guided them.
rows.anchor: أرشده { ومنهم من حقت } وجبت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Others were destined for error: disbelief by a prior decree.
rows.anchor: وجبت { عليه الضلالة } الكفر بالقضاء السابق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Travel to reflect on the traces left by nations who rejected the messengers.
rows.anchor: معتبرين بآثار الأمم المكذبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This means that Muhammad seeks their guidance with great effort.
rows.anchor: أي: تطلبها بجهدك

words: فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَن يُضِلُّ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not guide those He lets stray; the source supports this with the wording, 'Whomever God leads astray has no guide.'
rows.anchor: كقوله: من يضلل الله فلا هادي له

words: أَحَدُهُمَآ أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One man is mute and incapable of speech because he neither understands others nor can make himself understood.
rows.anchor: من الكلام، لأنه لا يفهم ولا يفهم عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kall means a burden or weight on his master, companion, or relative.
rows.anchor: ثقل ووبال { على مولاه } صاحبه وقريبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wherever he is sent, he brings no good because he cannot understand what is said or make himself understood.
rows.anchor: يرسله { لا يأت بخير } لأنه عاجز لا يفهم ما يقال له

words: هَلْ يَسْتَوِى هُوَ وَمَن يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mute man represents Ubayy ibn Khalaf, a burden to his people who harmed them; the just one represents Hamza ibn Abd al-Muttalib.
rows.anchor: ومن يأمر بالعدل حمزة بن عبد المطلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The just command is a call to God's oneness.
rows.anchor: وهو المؤمن يأمر بتوحيد الله سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path means a straight religion.
rows.anchor: دين مستقيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows what is hidden in the heavens and earth from His servants.
rows.anchor: علم ما غاب فيهما عن العباد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hour means the Resurrection.
rows.anchor: يعني: القيامة

words: إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ ٱلْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is as quick as a glance or nearer: God brings it in less than a blink when He wills.
rows.anchor: كالنظر بسرعة { أو هو أقرب } من ذلك إذا أردناه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People were born knowing nothing.
rows.anchor: أي: غير عالمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God created the faculties by which people learn and come to know what was unknown to them.
rows.anchor: خلق لكم الحواس التي بها يعلمون، ويقفون على ما يجهلون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will return the staff to its former state as a staff.
rows.anchor: أي: نردها عصا كما كانت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person's 'wing' is the upper arm through the root of the armpit; Moses is to put his hand under it.
rows.anchor: جناح الإنسان: عضده إلى أصل إبطه، يريد: أدخلها تحت جناحك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 'Without harm' means without leprosy or disease.
rows.anchor: برص أو داء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The white hand is another sign for Moses besides the staff.
rows.anchor: لك سوى العصا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hand was the greater of Moses's signs.
rows.anchor: وكانت يده أكبر آياته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh disbelieved God's blessings and grew arrogant toward His worship.
rows.anchor: كفر بأنعمي، وتكبر عن عبادتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks God to expand and soften his heart through faith and prophethood.
rows.anchor: وسع ولين لي قلبي بالإيمان والنبوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks God to make easy the task of conveying the message.
rows.anchor: وسهل علي ما أمرتني به من تبليغ الرسالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God chose Moses for messengership so that he would love God and carry out His command.
rows.anchor: اخترتك بالرسالة لكي تحبني وتقوم بأمري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The signs are the miracles God gave Moses and Aaron.
rows.anchor: يعني: بما أعطاهما من المعجزة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses and Aaron are told not to grow slack.
rows.anchor: لا تفترا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh had risen up and become arrogant.
rows.anchor: علا وتكبر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They should address Pharaoh by his kunya and promise faith's blessings: wealth, a long healthy life, and an eventual destination in Paradise.
rows.anchor: كنياه وعداه على الإيمان نعيما وعمرا طويلا في صحة، ومصيرا إلى الجنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 'Perhaps' reflects Moses and Aaron's hope: they go hoping for this, although God already knows Pharaoh's outcome.
rows.anchor: يعود إلى حال موسى وهارون. أي: اذهبا أنتما على رجائكما وطمعكما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They fear Pharaoh may hasten to kill and punish them.
rows.anchor: [يعجل علينا] بالقتل والعقوبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They also fear he may become arrogant and rebellious.
rows.anchor: يتكبر ويستعصي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is with Moses and Aaron by giving them help and victory.
rows.anchor: بالعون والنصرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God hears what Pharaoh says and sees what he does.
rows.anchor: ما يقول { وأرى } ما يفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ask Pharaoh to release the Israelites and stop enslaving them.
rows.anchor: أي: خل عنهم ولا تستسخرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ask him not to exhaust the Israelites with labor.
rows.anchor: ولا تتعبهم في العمل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sign is the shining hand and the staff.
rows.anchor: يعني: اليد البيضاء [والعصا] { والسلام على من اتبع الهدى } سلم من أسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever submits to the guidance is safe.
rows.anchor: سلم من أسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Punishment falls on whoever denies God's prophets and turns away from faith.
rows.anchor: أنبياء الله { وتولى } أعرض عن الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one created from the earth is Adam.
rows.anchor: يعني: آدم عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People return to the earth at death.
rows.anchor: عند الموت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God brings people out of the earth again at the Resurrection.
rows.anchor: عند البعث { تارة } مرة { أخرى }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person shown the signs is Pharaoh, and the signs are the nine miracles.
rows.anchor: يعني: فرعون { آياتنا كلها } الآيات التسع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh denied the signs, claimed they were magic, and refused to submit.
rows.anchor: بها، وزعم أنها سحر { وأبى } أن يسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The land Pharaoh means is Egypt.
rows.anchor: من أرض مصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are told to settle on their plot without disagreement among themselves.
rows.anchor: اعزموا على الكيد من غير اختلاف بينكم فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They should come together in ordered ranks to make themselves more imposing.
rows.anchor: مجتمعين مصطفين؛ ليكون أشد لهيبتكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one who prevails today will prosper.
rows.anchor: أي: قد سعد اليوم من غلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ask Moses either to cast his staff to the ground or let them cast first.
rows.anchor: عصاك من يدك إلى الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plural ʿiṣiyy means staffs.
rows.anchor: جمع العصا

words: يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their cords and staffs seemed to move through trickery, and Moses thought they were moving toward him.
rows.anchor: وذلك أنها تحركت بنوع حيلة وتمويه، وظن موسى أنها تسعى نحوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses felt fear inwardly, thinking he might fail to win and so not be believed.
rows.anchor: لا تخف إنك أنت الأعلى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God reassures Moses that he will prevail.
rows.anchor: لا تخف إنك أنت الأعلى } الغالب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word means to swallow.
rows.anchor: تلقف } تبتلع { ما صنعوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What the magicians made was a magician's scheme; a magician does not succeed wherever he goes.
rows.anchor: ولا يسعد الساحر حيث ما كان

words: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses cast his staff, which swallowed everything they made; the sorcerers then fell into prostration.
rows.anchor: فألقى موسى عصاه فتلقفت كل الذي صنعوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The magicians fell down prostrate to God and declared belief in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.
rows.anchor: خروا ساجدين لله تعالى { قالوا آمنا برب هارون وموسى }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh accuses the magicians of believing Moses before receiving his permission.
rows.anchor: صدقتموه { قبل أن آذن لكم إنه لكبيركم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh alleges that Moses is their chief and teacher of magic.
rows.anchor: معلمكم { الذي علمكم السحر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their limbs will be cut crosswise: the right hand and left foot.
rows.anchor: اليد اليمنى والرجل اليسرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They will be crucified on the tops of palm trees.
rows.anchor: على رؤوس النخل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh threatens that they will learn whether he or the Lord of Moses gives the more severe and lasting punishment.
rows.anchor: أنا أو رب موسى { وأبقى } وأدوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The magicians will not choose Pharaoh's religion over the clear proofs, certainty, and guidance, nor over their Creator.
rows.anchor: لن نختار دينك { على ما جاءنا من البينات } اليقين والهدى { والذي فطرنا }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They tell Pharaoh to do as he pleases by cutting and crucifying them.
rows.anchor: فاصنع ما أنت صانع من القطع والصلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh's authority and rule are confined to this worldly life.
rows.anchor: إنما سلطانك وملكك في هذه الحياة الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their sins are the association with God in which they had lived.
rows.anchor: الشرك الذين كنا فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They also seek forgiveness for the magic Pharaoh forced them to learn.
rows.anchor: إكراهك إيانا على تعلم السحر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is better than Pharaoh and more enduring, since Pharaoh will perish.
rows.anchor: لأنك فان هالك

words: إِنِّى خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aaron feared that leaving the Israelites to follow Moses would divide them into factions that might kill each other, after which Moses would blame him for causing the division.
rows.anchor: خشيت إن فارقتهم واتبعتك أن يصيروا حزبين يقتل بعضهم بعضا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aaron says Moses did not keep his charge to manage the Israelites well.
rows.anchor: لم تحفظ وصيتي في حسن الخلافة عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The explanation of this phrase is given in Surat al-Hijr.
rows.anchor: مفسر في سورة الحجر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The flower of worldly life is its adornment and beauty.
rows.anchor: أي: زينتها وبهجتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gives them these things as a trial.
rows.anchor: لتجعل ذلك فتنة لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The provision of the Lord, reserved for the Hereafter, is better and more enduring.
rows.anchor: لك في المعاد { خير وأبقى } أكثر وأدوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The family ordered to pray means Quraysh.
rows.anchor: يعني: قريشا

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view says the family ordered to pray means the Prophet's household.
rows.anchor: وقيل: أهل بيته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not ask sustenance for His creation or for Himself; He provides for them.
rows.anchor: لخلقنا ولا لنفسك { نحن نرزقك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ultimate outcome is Paradise, for the God-fearing—meaning the Prophet and those who believe him.
rows.anchor: الجنة { للتقوى } لأهل التقوى. يعني: لك ولمن صدقك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These verses were revealed when the Messenger borrowed from a Jewish man, who insisted on collateral before lending, and the Messenger was saddened.
rows.anchor: لما استسلف رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من يهودي وأبى أن يعطيه إلا برهن، وحزن لذلك رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

words: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The speakers are the polytheists, who ask Muhammad for the signs they proposed.
rows.anchor: يعني: المشركين { لولا } هلا { يأتينا } محمد عليه السلام

words: أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The proof from earlier scriptures is the Qur'an, which explains what is in the Torah, Gospel, and Psalms.
rows.anchor: { ما في الصحف الأولى } يعني: في القرآن بيان ما في التوراة والإنجيل والزبور

words: وَلَوْ أَنَّآ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِعَذَابٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 'Before it' means before the Qur'an was sent down.
rows.anchor: من قبل نزول القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They would have been humiliated by punishment and disgraced in Hell.
rows.anchor: بالعذاب { ونخزى } في جهنم
